---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new component, feature, or improvement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

A clear description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Use Case

How does this feature help elderly users? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you imagine this feature working. Include code examples or mockups if possible.

## Accessibility Considerations

- Touch target size: [e.g., needs >= 48dp button]
- Font size: [e.g., needs large text labels]
- Voice interaction: [e.g., should support voice commands]
- Other: [any other a11y concerns]

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've thought about.

## Additional Context

Any other context, research findings, or references that support this request.
